dedupe_keys.name: a machine learning based predictive model for liquefaction ejecta manifestation in stratigraphically variable sites

description: A Machine-Learning Based Predictive Model for Liquefaction Ejecta Manifestation in Stratigraphically Variable Sites is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Lianne Brito, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This project presents a machine learning based probabilistic predictive model for estimating the potential severity of free-field surface ejecta in stratigraphically variable and interbedded deposits as a measure of liquefaction manifestation and damage. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-4355-wc05. Keywords: machine learning,  finite-element modelling,  system-level site response,  liquefaction,  ejecta,  probabilistic models. Published 2025-05-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
